
# Load Packages
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("00_requirements.R")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)
```

# Import Datasets
```{r import-data}
btc_raw <- read.csv(
  "Data/BTC-USD.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
sp500_raw <- read.csv(
  "Data/SPX.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
ief_raw <- read.csv(
  "Data/IEF.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
```

# Initial Data Exploration
```{r initial-inspection}
dim(btc_raw)
dim(sp500_raw)
dim(ief_raw)
names(btc_raw)
```
# check for missing data
```{r missing-inspection}
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Bitcoin", "S&P 500", "IEF"),
  Missing_Values = c(
    sum(is.na(btc_raw)),
    sum(is.na(sp500_raw)),
    sum(is.na(ief_raw))
  )
)
kable(
  missing_summary,
  caption = "Missing Values in Original Datasets"
)
```

# Jan 1 2020 to Oct 1 2026
```{r date-filtering}
start_date <- as.Date("2020-01-01")
end_date <- as.Date("2026-10-01")

btc_clean <- btc_clean %>%
  filter(Date >= start_date, Date <= end_date)

sp500_clean <- sp500_clean %>%
  filter(Date >= start_date, Date <= end_date)

ief_clean <- ief_clean %>%
  filter(Date >= start_date, Date <= end_date)
```

# Relevant Variables
```{r select-variables}
btc_analysis <- btc_clean %>%
  select(Date, Adjusted_Close)

sp500_analysis <- sp500_clean %>%
  select(Date, Adjusted_Close)

ief_analysis <- ief_clean %>%
  select(Date, Adjusted_Close)
```

# Select monthly data
```{r monthly-function}
get_monthly_data <- function(data) {

  data %>%
    mutate(
      Month = floor_date(Date, unit = "month")
    ) %>%
    group_by(Month) %>%
    slice_max(
      order_by = Date,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r monthly-datasets}
btc_monthly <- get_monthly_data(btc_analysis)
sp500_monthly <- get_monthly_data(sp500_analysis)
ief_monthly <- get_monthly_data(ief_analysis)
```

# combine monthly datasets
```{r combine-data}
monthly_combined <- btc_monthly %>%
  select(Month, Bitcoin = Adjusted_Close) %>%
  inner_join(
    sp500_monthly %>%
      select(Month, SP500 = Adjusted_Close),
    by = "Month"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    ief_monthly %>%
      select(Month, IEF = Adjusted_Close),
    by = "Month"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Month)
```

# Examine  Cleaned Datasets
```{r cleaned-summary}
cleaned_summary <- data.frame(
  Asset = c("Bitcoin", "S&P 500", "IEF"),

  Observations = c(
    nrow(btc_clean),
    nrow(sp500_clean),
    nrow(ief_clean),
  ),

  Missing_Values = c(
    sum(is.na(btc_clean)),
    sum(is.na(sp500_clean)),
    sum(is.na(ief_clean)),
  ),

  First_Date = c(
    min(btc_clean$Date),
    min(sp500_clean$Date),
    min(ief_clean$Date),
  ),

  Last_Date = c(
    max(btc_clean$Date),
    max(sp500_clean$Date),
    max(ief_clean$Date),
  )
)
```
# save cleaned datasets
```{r save-data}
dir.create("Output", showWarnings = FALSE)
save(btc_clean,sp500_clean, ief_clean, btc_monthly,sp500_monthly,ief_monthly,monthly_combined,file = "Output/cleaned_data.RData")
write.csv(monthly_combined,"Output/monthly_combined.csv",row.names = FALSE)
```
